workflow.name: Tokenomics Value Theft and Lock Hunt v2
workflow.description: Deployment- and scope-derived hunt for permissionless theft, over-claim, vote-weight inflation, staking conservation failure, or unauthorized lock of tokenomics value. Import-valid v2.2: globally unique stage keys, a single dedup consume-all boundary, explicit proxy/storage/initialization coverage, and per-operation cross-contract neighborhoods for composition analysis.

steps.name: Freeze tokenomics program scope
Map tokenomics custody and distribution surfaces
steps.content:
Map current in-scope deployed contracts that custody or distribute locked tokens, staking assets/shares, emissions, vote weight, gauges, vesting, and Merkle/claim rewards. Derive modules from code and deployment evidence instead of hard-coded Pendle paths. For each permissionless operation trace owner/beneficiary identity, balances/shares, unlock/epoch/week/checkpoint math, vote bias/slope, emission conservation, claimed ledgers/roots/proofs, bridge/relayer boundaries, external calls, and terminal transfers. Record exact invariants and accepted-impact candidates.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

Web3 architecture expansion: identify whether the operation is reached through a transparent proxy, UUPS proxy, beacon, diamond/facet, minimal clone, metamorphic deployment, delegatecall-based module, or direct implementation. Trace proxy -> implementation/facet resolution, initializer state, upgrade authorization, storage slots/layout across relevant versions, selector routing, and every attacker-influenceable delegatecall target. Check deployed bytecode/configuration evidence rather than assuming source deployment.

For each operation, include its local cross-contract neighborhood: direct callers and callees, callbacks/hooks, shared storage/accounting dependencies, tokens/oracles/bridges it trusts, and related public operations that can prepare or consume its state. Follow at least two contract hops where source and deployment evidence permit. Populate the proxy/storage and cross-contract output fields even when the conclusion is "direct deployment / no relevant edge", with evidence.

steps.name: Tokenomics hypotheses A: ownership, locks, claims
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_operation_label}}. Generate only precise permissionless hypotheses for early or foreign withdrawal, position substitution, unauthorized beneficiary/recipient, claim replay/double claim/over-claim, root/domain separation, staking share inflation, reward debt/index error, or permanent lock. Require exact state identity, sequence, fund source, victim, arithmetic, locations, guards, accepted impact, and falsification target.

steps.name: Tokenomics hypotheses B: vote, epoch, checkpoint composition
Deduplicate tokenomics root causes
steps.content: Cluster {{multi_output_depth_2}} by faulty identity/accounting/checkpoint operation, attacker primitive, victim/value source, invariant, and fix. Keep distinct bugs separate when their fixes differ. Create stable fingerprints and preserve trigger variants. Discard self-only expected behavior, privileged-only paths, scope-excluded trust assumptions, known issues, and unsupported deployment claims.

steps.name: Independent tokenomics verification
steps.content: Try to falsify {{dedup_canonical_hypothesis_id}}. Required gates: deployed in-scope reachability; ownership/beneficiary binding; lock/unlock authorization; claim replay ledger and domain/root binding; vote-weight/checkpoint ordering; staking/emission conservation; external/cross-chain trust per scope; known-issue/audit dedup; realistic attacker gain or accepted freeze/governance impact. Record exact arithmetic and pass/fail/blocked/not-applicable per gate. supported requires an end-to-end permissionless accepted impact. Produce a pinned fork plan.

steps.name: Tokenomics fork PoC
steps.content:
For supported candidates, implement/run a pinned fork/local regression with attacker and victim positions. Capture timestamps/epochs/checkpoints, claims and proofs, balances/shares/vote weight/emissions before/after, attacker and victim delta, gas/capital/lock opportunity cost, trace, and repeatability. Never submit public-chain transactions. Set PoC verdict with artifacts and minimal reproduction.

Cost gate: if {{dedup_triage_priority}} is not `high`, do not build or run a harness. Return poc_verdict=`skipped_by_priority` with the reason. For smart-contract candidates, use {{extra.fork_rpc_url}} and {{extra.fork_block}} when supplied.

steps.name: Apply tokenomics program gate
steps.content:
Apply the immutable program scope contract to this technically verified candidate.
Program evidence is read directly from immutable extras after dedup: snapshot={{extra.program_rules_snapshot}}; checked_at={{extra.program_rules_checked_at}}; URL={{extra.bug_bounty_url}}; deployment={{extra.deployment_evidence}}; known_issues={{extra.known_issues_snapshot}}; testing_constraints={{extra.authorized_test_constraints}}.
Candidate: {{dedup_canonical_summary}}. Root cause: {{dedup_canonical_root_cause}} at {{dedup_canonical_location}}.
Technical verdict: {{verify_technical_verdict}}. Production reachability: {{verify_production_reachability}}.
Observed effect: {{poc_observed_effect}}. Reproduction verdict: {{poc_poc_verdict}}. Reproduction evidence: {{poc_poc_evidence}}.

Set eligibility_verdict=eligible only when the exact affected asset is in scope, the observed effect matches a named accepted impact, no exclusion or known-issue rule controls, and required deployment facts are evidenced. Use ineligible for a controlling exclusion or absent impact; use blocked for missing program/deployment facts. Assign severity only from the supplied program language and measured impact. Do not use popularity, theoretical TVL, scanner confidence, or remembered platform conventions.

steps.name: Report verified tokenomics exploit
